name: K12 Schools Indian Curriculum
format: live interactive classes in a virtual classroom; 1:20 class size
timings: 4 hours 10 minutes a day, Monday to Friday plus alternate Saturdays
timings_note: Alternate Saturdays; exact clock times not shown.

curriculum.summary: Follows the National Curriculum Framework 2020 for Grades 1-5, with textbooks and workbooks sent home. A third language (French or German) is optional from Grade 3; STEM is an optional add-on.

fees_note: No amounts on the pages read; an admission fees policy and a pay-fees page are linked from the site.
how_to_check: Primary School page on k12onlineschools.com for hours; fee policy page is linked from the menu.
